title: AION 2 Builds: Skills, Stigmas and Talent Planner
description: Plan AION 2 skill points with a Global calculator, choose skill options and Stigmas, save your setup, and test practical class attack loops.
summary: Build a setup for your region, role and unlocked skills. Use a Global skill planner for point allocation, then test the actual choices and attack loop in game.
quickAnswer: Choose skills and Stigmas for your activity, select unlocked specialization options and practice the loop manually. Use the Global Build Planner Skills tab to budget points with Raise/Lower; its local plan stays in your browser.

workflow.title: Assemble a working build
workflow.caption: Select skill options, equip your role tools, and practice the loop manually.

steps.label: Match the context
steps.description: Record region, level, activity, and whether your party supplies healing or overlapping buffs.

steps.label: Select actual skill options
steps.description: Spend within your budget, then explicitly choose the unlocked specialization used by the example.

steps.label: Equip the role tools
steps.description: Fill only visible Stigma slots and keep the recovery or defensive tool your job requires.

steps.label: Test the interaction
steps.description: Manually test the expected trigger or reset before adding a repeating attack sequence.

steps.label: Save and change one part
steps.description: Record selected options and retest one failed interaction or missing party function at a time.
